table.name: bpay_next_case_hold_transition
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (case_component_id, case_id, candidate_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_case_component(id, case_id, candidate_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES tms_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (allocation_result_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_case_allocation_result(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (cause_job_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_job(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (command_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_command(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (hold_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_case_hold(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (instruction_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_run_case_instruction(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (run_worker_id, candidate_id) REFERENCES private.bpay_next_run_worker(id, candidate_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER bpay_next_case_hold_transition_immutable_v1 BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON private.bpay_next_case_hold_transition FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.bpay_next_effect_immutable_v1()
CREATE TRIGGER bpay_next_case_hold_transition_truncate_v1 BEFORE TRUNCATE ON private.bpay_next_case_hold_transition FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.bpay_next_effect_immutable_v1()
